items.headline: Kickers and a resurgent USC steal the show in Week 9

items.headline: No. 1 Miami rallies to remain unbeaten, looks ahead to No. 5 Notre Dame
items.description: Malachi Toney and No. 1 Miami rallied in the fourth quarter, extracting a 38-35 win over North Carolina and avoiding a seismic upset to improve to 8-0 with Notre Dame on the schedule next week.
